howToPlay: Hank is an Epic tank with 5500 health and a range of 10. Charge attacks to engage in battle and use the Water Balloons gadget to slow enemies or the Barricade gadget to reduce incoming damage. Utilize the Its Gonna Blow star power for extra movement speed or the Take Cover star power to resist damage while near walls.
gears: Use the SPEED, HEALTH, and DAMAGE gears to boost mobility and survivability during combat. The SHIELD gear is effective for increasing defense, while the GADGET COOLDOWN gear helps in using your abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler is ideal for players who prefer a durable tank that controls space and thrives in close-quarters engagements near walls.
